seoTitle: Color Space Plotter: Palette in 3D RGB, HSL or OKLab
metaDescription: Plot palette colours in a rotatable 3D view of RGB, HSL or OKLab to find gaps and clusters. Free, local, with keyboard controls.
intro: Draws each colour of a palette as a point in 3D and lets you rotate the view, with the coordinates listed in a table.
why:
A list of hex codes hides uneven lightness steps and clusters. In OKLab the vertical axis is lightness, so a palette with equal steps looks like a clean column. In RGB you see how colours fill the cube. In HSL you see hue as an angle around a cylinder.

Rotate with the sliders or buttons, which work without a mouse. The table under the plot gives the exact numbers for each point.
howTo: Choose RGB cube, HSL cylinder or OKLab.
Rotate and tilt with the sliders or buttons.
Read the table for exact values.

faq.q: Which space is best for checking steps?
faq.a: OKLab, because distances there match perceived differences more closely.
This version uses sliders and buttons only.
They may be close, or aligned along the view direction. Rotate to check.
Points are sorted by depth, not shaded.
